scientific_integrity: Arch-factorization bijection and exact three-state transfer prove the formula for all nonnegative compositions; exhaustive tests through binary length 14 are reproducibility checks and not a replacement for proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed binary alphabet; the exact rational formulas determine only the first and second moments. The uniform-source asymptotic does not assert a central limit or a conditional fixed-composition asymptotic. Independently discovering an equivalent formulation in unindexed literature remains possible.
title: Exact second-moment law and nonconcentration of shortest absent binary subsequences
